_description: Real wall-clock recovery from a real SIGKILL to a running trainer.
The job trains for warmup_seconds first so recovery has something to
recover from, then its container is killed with docker kill and the
harness measures how long the system takes to reach a real COMPLETED
state with a real final accuracy.
epochs is deliberately > 1 so the job outlives the warmup; a job that
finished before the kill would measure nothing, and the scenario fails
